## Goal

Complete E209 IT code entrant measurement and determine continuation

## Summary

E209 IT code entrant measurement completed. Prototype tools/it_code_entrant_v2.py and tools/it_entrant_advisor.py measure segment newcomer fractions for 5 USAspending PSC codes using FY2023 current vs FY2018-2022 prior window comparison. Key finding: bimodal entry pattern — unlike NIH SBIR's unimodal common-entry pattern, federal IT shows 2 codes with significant entry (DA01, 7A21), 1 surviving the 0.30 kill gate (DA10), and 2 with 0 newcomers (7030, D304). This closes the 'fragmented ⇒ entry' inference transfer from NIH SBIR to federal IT. Experiment result recorded at EXPERIMENTS/E209-it-code-entrant/RESULT.md. Next: validate bimodal pattern robustness or pursue fresh observation in new domain per D083.

## Next
